specification_sections: 3.2.2 Higher pronouns, relatives, negatives, passive present, time expressions, modals, future/conditional, plural imperfect, imperative, participles, comparisons and derivation

questions_and_answers.format: Original paired practice ordered by marks
questions_and_answers.assessment_review: Original retrieval, grammar and application practice. Short mark groups are practice allocations. Official Higher writing uses a minimum-50-word translation (10 marks), a roughly 90-word response to three bullets (15 marks) and a roughly 150-word response to two bullets (25 marks).
